content_zh:
龙国篇龙国篇第十三章武神圣铠
“哈哈哈哈哈哈......”
“这么些年来你的进展虽然不少但比起我，我可是一个真正的S级武神，A级与S级虽说只有一字之差，但我是谁，我可是世界蛇十大护法之一“
“浴火红莲”
“小妹，我不得不承认你变强了许多，若是其他S级武神你已经赢了”
“但是，你碰上的是我”
“小妹，看好了这才是真正的S级武神”
随着一声呐喊，那声音在空旷的空气中久久回响，震颤着每一寸空间。
她的身躯在呐喊中轻轻颤抖，仿佛被一股无形的力量所撼动，武神之魂在她体内悄然觉醒，开始汇聚成璀璨的光华。
旧日的铠甲在她身上逐渐剥落，每一片碎片都承载着过往的战斗与磨砺，而与此同时，全新的铠甲在她肌肤之下缓缓生成，闪烁着神秘而耀眼的光芒。
这不仅仅是一套铠甲，更是艾露内心力量的外在显现，是她坚定不移的意志与孤独而高傲的灵魂的象征。
一股股磅礴的力量如同涓涓细流，源源不断地涌入艾露的体内，它们在她血脉中奔腾，仿佛要冲破一切束缚，将她推向力量的巅峰。
在这股力量的推动下，艾露的身体缓缓升起，仿佛被无形的羽翼所托举，漂浮在半空之中。
随着旧铠甲的完全脱落，她身上的伤口也奇迹般地开始愈合，每一道伤痕都以肉眼可见的速度消失，取而代之的是新生的肌肤，散发着淡淡的莹光。
“呵……”
一声低沉而有力的呐喊在空旷中回荡，仿佛瞬间点燃了周遭的空气，温度骤升，犹如夏日午后的烈阳提前降临。
随着这股热量的蔓延，脚下的土地逐渐失去了往日的湿润，变得干裂，细小的沙石在无形的烘烤下变得灼热，仿佛每一粒都在诉说着高温的故事。
艾露化铠的身躯宛如一座移动的火山，滚滚热浪自其体内汹涌而出，向四周无差别地倾泻，形成了一道道扭曲的热气波纹，所过之处，草木枯焦，水源干涸，仿佛连空气都被点燃，发出噼啪作响的爆裂声。
这股力量，既原始又狂野，让周遭的一切生灵都感受到了前所未有的压迫感。
在这股炽热无比的气息中，艾希只觉呼吸困难，仿佛每一次呼吸都像是在吞噬着灼热的火焰，喉咙干涸得几乎要裂开。

她的皮肤在热浪的侵袭下变得通红，汗水如雨下，却在接触的瞬间就被蒸发得无影无踪，只留下点点盐渍，在皮肤上勾勒出斑驳的痕迹。
四周的空气仿佛凝固，沉重得让人几乎窒息，而那无处不在的热浪，更是如同无形的锁链，将她紧紧束缚在这片焦灼的地狱中。
在这一刻，艾露不再是一个普通的S级武神，而是一个真正意义上的S级巅峰武神。
她深切地体悟着体内涌动的磅礴力量，那仿佛能触及万物核心、点燃世间万物的烈焰，这股力量，既让她感到前所未有的强大，也让她心中五味杂陈。
艾露的声音在此时轻柔而低回，如同夜风中摇曳的烛光：“师傅，我确实变得更强了，但这力量的代价，是我失去了许多曾经珍视之物。
继承了您这份无上的力量后，我的心，承载着难以言喻的苦楚。”
周遭的生物在这股足以焚天煮海的炽热气息面前，纷纷惊慌失措，四散奔逃，唯有艾露，身着铠甲，坚毅地屹立不动。
她的身影，在熊熊烈焰的映照下更显伟岸，仿佛她自身已成为力量的化身，无畏且庄严，更像一位火焰女神。
艾希大惊：“这......这是武神圣铠！”
艾露大笑：“哈哈哈哈哈......你居然也认得武神圣铠”
“武神之力化铠有三个等级划分，最初的武神斗铠到——武神圣铠——武神神铠”
“如今这世界上拥有武神神铠的也不过才7人”
“所以说，那些等级上的S级武神，并不算真正意义上的S级武神”
艾希的心中涌动着无尽的敬畏与惊叹，却未曾有过一丝退缩之意。
她深知，唯有历经风雨的洗礼，方能铸就真正的强大。
在她的心中，艾露那武神圣铠的光辉，如同一座指引方向的灯塔，照亮了她前行的道路。
她暗暗发誓，要以那神圣不可侵犯的武神圣铠为追求，不懈修炼，让自己的实力在磨砺中一步步攀升。
艾希清晰地认识到，自己与艾露之间横亘着一条难以逾越的鸿沟。
content_en:
Dragon Kingdom Arc Dragon Kingdom Arc Chapter 13 Martial Divine Armor
"Hahahahahaha..."
"Although you have made a lot of progress over the years, compared to me, I am a true S-level Martial God. Although there is only one word difference between A-level and S-level, who am I? I am one of the top ten guardians of the World Snake."
"Red Lotus Bathed in Fire"
"Little sister, I have to admit that you have become much stronger. If you were the other S-class Martial God, you would have already won."
"But it was me you met."
"Little sister, take a look and see that this is the real S-class Martial God."
Following a shout, the sound echoed in the empty air for a long time, shaking every inch of space.
Her body trembled slightly as she screamed, as if being shaken by an invisible force. The soul of the God of War quietly awakened in her body and began to gather into a bright brilliance.
The old armor gradually peeled off on her body, and each fragment carried the past battles and hardships. At the same time, the new armor slowly formed under her skin, shining with a mysterious and dazzling light.
This is not only a set of armor, but also an external manifestation of Ellu's inner strength, a symbol of her unwavering will and lonely and proud soul.
Wave after wave of majestic power poured into Ellu's body like a trickle. They surged through her blood, as if they wanted to break through all constraints and push her to the peak of strength.
Driven by this force, Ellu's body slowly rose, as if being lifted by invisible wings, floating in the air.
As the old armor completely fell off, the wounds on her body miraculously began to heal. Each scar disappeared at a speed visible to the naked eye, and was replaced by new skin, exuding a faint gleaming light.
"Heh..."
A low and powerful shout echoed in the open space, as if it instantly ignited the surrounding air, and the temperature rose sharply, like the scorching sun coming early on a summer afternoon.
As this heat spreads, the ground under your feet gradually loses its previous moisture and becomes dry and cracked. The fine sand and stones become hot under the invisible baking, as if each grain is telling a story about the high temperature.
Ellu's armored body was like a moving volcano, with rolling heat waves surging out of its body and pouring indiscriminately around, forming twisted ripples of heat. Wherever it passed, the vegetation was scorched and the water sources dried up. It was as if even the air was ignited, making a crackling and crackling sound.
This power is both primitive and wild, making all living creatures around it feel an unprecedented sense of oppression.
In this extremely hot breath, Ai Xi felt it was difficult to breathe, as if every breath was swallowing a scorching flame, and her throat was so dry that it was almost split.
Her skin turned red under the attack of the heat wave, and sweat poured down like rain, but it was evaporated without a trace at the moment of contact, leaving only little salt stains, which outlined mottled marks on her skin.
The air around her seemed to be frozen, so heavy that it was almost suffocating, and the ubiquitous heat wave was like an invisible chain, tightly binding her in this scorching hell.
At this moment, Elu is no longer an ordinary S-level Martial God, but a true S-level peak Martial God.
She deeply realized the majestic power surging within her body, the flame that seemed to touch the core of everything and ignite everything in the world. This power not only made her feel stronger than ever before, but also made her feel mixed.
Elu's voice was soft and low at this time, like a candle swaying in the night wind: "Master, I have indeed become stronger, but the price of this power is that I have lost many things I once cherished.
After inheriting your supreme power, my heart is filled with unspeakable pain. "
The surrounding creatures panicked and fled in all directions in front of this hot breath that could burn the sky and boil the sea. Only Elu, wearing armor, stood firm and motionless.
her figure, even more majestic under the blazing flames, as if she has become the embodiment of power, fearless and solemn, more like a fire goddess.
Ai Xi was shocked: "This...this is the sacred armor of martial arts!"
Elu laughed: "Hahahahaha...you actually recognize the Martial Arts Armor"
"There are three levels of armor transformed from the power of the Martial God. The initial Martial God Battle Armor is - the Martial God Divine Armor - the Martial God Divine Armor."
"Today, there are only 7 people in the world who possess the God of War Armor."
"So, those S-class Martial Gods are not considered S-Class Martial Gods in the true sense."
Ai Xi's heart was filled with endless awe and wonder, but she never flinched.
She knows very well that only through the baptism of wind and rain can we build true strength.
In her heart, the brilliance of Eluna's sacred armor was like a beacon guiding the direction, illuminating her path forward.
She secretly vowed to pursue the sacred and inviolable martial arts armor, practice unremittingly, and let her strength increase step by step through tempering.
Ai Xi clearly realized that there was an insurmountable gap between herself and Ellu.
